name: 专注计时
code: let left=25*60,active=false;root.innerHTML='25:00';function draw(){document.getElementById('timer').textContent=String(Math.floor(left/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(left%60).padStart(2,'0')}document.getElementById('toggle').onclick=()=>{if(!left)left=25*60;active=!active;document.getElementById('toggle').textContent=active?'暂停':'开始';draw()};setInterval(()=>{if(active&&left>0){left--;draw();if(!left){active=false;document.getElementById('toggle').textContent='重来'}}},1000)
